title: VTA Notifications — List — payload
description: A client with standing in a trust context lists the notifications its VTA holds there for the principal — for example, every notification of the kind `election`, which with the elections the community's own list shows is the member's view of the elections they may take part in (VTI-NTF-063). Dismissed and lapsed notifications are left out unless asked for. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

heldBy.description: Only notifications whose thing is held by this DID — for example, one community's elections.

includeDismissed.description: Also return notifications the principal dismissed. Absent or false: active ones only.

includeLapsed.description: Also return notifications that are withdrawn, or whose `validUntil` has passed, and that the VTA still holds (VTI-NTF-052). Absent or false: only notifications whose thing can still be acted on.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, for the same filters. The VTA refuses one it did not issue.

Response.title: VTA Notifications — List — response payload
Response.description: One page of the held notifications that match, most recently received first.

nextCursor.description: Present when more items remain; absent on the last page.
